note: Kasirzadeh contrasts a 'checklist' model of progress, built on solving predefined problems, with a 'generative encounter' model driven by real-world problems, and argues that AI disrupts the incentives of the first. She calls for redesigning how mathematical work is valued and names four areas that need new mathematics, including understanding machine-generated proofs.
title: A New Dawn For Mathematical Progress
who: Atoosa Kasirzadeh (Carnegie Mellon University; DeepMind Institute)
